{{external|rs=Bird's nests|dw=Bird Nest}}
'''Bird nests''' are items found through activities such as [[Woodcutting]], [[bird house trapping]], and killing the [[Giant mole]]. There are several varieties of nests, which either contain [[seeds]], [[ring]]s, or [[bird's egg]]s. They are [[Members]] only and will not appear while woodcutting as a free player.

Most activities reward a random selection of seed, ring, and egg nests. Additionally, some activities reward [[clue nest]]s, which contain a [[clue scroll]]. Opening all types of bird nests will provide an [[Bird nest (empty)|empty nest]]. 

When [[woodcutting]], a roll is done to determine the type of nest the player will receive. The table contains 100 slots: 3/100 [[Bird nest (egg)|egg nest]] (one for each colour), 32/100 [[Bird nest (ring)|ring nest]], 65/100 seed nest. When wearing a [[strung rabbit foot]], five seed slots are removed, making the chances 3/95 for bird's egg, 32/95 for ring and 60/95 for seeds.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1055815273763217414|date=26 October 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102252|archivedate=26 May 2020|quote=If you've got the rabbit foot necklace, pick number 0-94 inclusive. Otherwise, pick number 0-99 inclusive. 0 = red egg, 1 = blue egg, 2 = green egg, 3-34 = ring, otherwise it's seeds.}} [[Twitcher's gloves]] also increase the chance to receive a particular type of nest by approximately 20%.

==Obtaining==
*Randomly dropped while [[Woodcutting]].
**The chance of getting a bird nest from a tree is 1/256 each time you would normally get a log, regardless of the type of tree. 
**Players who equip a [[Woodcutting cape]] will have an additional 10% chance of receiving bird nests from chopping trees.
*Reward from [[Managing Miscellania]] when subjects are tasked with collecting maple, teak, or mahogany logs.
*Reward from offering [[bird's egg]]s to the [[shrine]] in the [[Woodcutting Guild]].
*Received from [[Wyson the gardener]] in [[Falador Park]] in exchange for [[mole claw]] and [[mole skin]].
*Received when emptying [[bird house traps]] on [[Fossil Island]].
*Received when chopping [[ent]] trunks.
*Received as a guaranteed reward for participating in and fully pruning all five [[Entling|entlings]] during the [[friendly ent]] [[Forestry#Forestry events|Forestry event]]. This will always be an egg nest.
*Received as a possible tip during [[Gnome Restaurant]] minigame.
*Obtainable from [[Hunters' loot sacks]] which are obtained from [[Hunters' Rumours]]. 
*Obtainable from rummaging [[Vale offerings]] which are obtained from [[Vale Totems]]. 

==Types of nests==
===Seed nest===
{{Main|Bird nest (seeds)}}
Seed nests contain a random [[tree seed|tree]] or [[fruit tree seed]]. These nests can be obtained through Woodcutting, bird house trapping, chopping [[ent]] trunks, [[Managing Miscellania]], or during [[Gnome Restaurant]]. They can also be obtained by using a [[bird's egg]] on the [[shrine]] in the [[Woodcutting Guild]].

Wearing a [[strung rabbit foot]] decreases the chance of seed nests while woodcutting by replacing some seed nests drops with ring and egg nests.<ref name=":0">Jagex. [https://clips.twitch.tv/SingleAmericanReindeerPRChase OldSchoolRS Twitch stream]. 21 November 2018. Mod Ash: "increases the chance of the nest being eggs or a ring rather than seeds."</ref> However, wearing a strung rabbit foot while [[bird house trapping]] is not explicitly stated to decrease the chance of getting seed nests.<ref name=":1">{{PlainCiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/collection-log-improvements-and-the-last-of-poll-74?oldschool=1|title=Collection Log Improvements and The Last of Poll 74|newsdate=7 April 2021}}</ref>

=== Ring nest ===
{{Main|Bird nest (ring)}}
Ring nests contain a random type of either [[gold ring|gold]], [[sapphire ring|sapphire]], [[emerald ring|emerald]], [[ruby ring|ruby]], or [[diamond ring]].

Ring nests are found from woodcutting, Managing Miscellania, bird house trapping, chopping ent trunks, and trading mole parts with [[Wyson]].

Wearing a [[strung rabbit foot]] increases the chance of ring nests while woodcutting by replacing some seed nest drops with ring and egg nests.<ref name=":0" /> Wearing a strung rabbit foot while [[bird house trapping]] increases the chance of ring nests, but it is not specified how this affects empty or seed nest drops.<ref name=":1" />

===Egg nest===
{{Main|Bird nest (egg)}}
Egg nests contain one of the three types of [[bird's egg]]s. The colour of the egg is visible in the nest, so it is possible to tell which egg will be received before searching the nest. The eggs can be offered to the [[shrine]] in the [[Woodcutting Guild]] to receive 100 [[Prayer]] experience as well as a seed nest or piece of the [[evil chicken outfit]].

Egg nests are received from woodcutting, bird house trapping, chopping [[ent]] trunks, [[Forestry#Friendly Ent|friendly ent]] events, and [[Managing Miscellania]].

Wearing a [[strung rabbit foot]] increases the chance of egg nests while woodcutting by replacing some seed nest drops with ring and egg nests.<ref name=":0" /> Wearing a strung rabbit foot while [[bird house trapping]] increases the chance of egg nests, but it is not specified how this affects empty or seed nest drops.<ref name=":1" />

===Wyson nest===
{{Main|Bird nest (Wyson)}}
A variant type of seed nest is received from [[Wyson the gardener]] in [[Falador Park]]. These nests commonly contain low level [[allotment seeds]], but can also reward high level [[herb seed|herb]], [[tree seed|tree]], and [[fruit tree seeds]]. Wyson provides 1 nest in exchange for each [[mole claw]] and [[mole skin]] given to him. The mole parts can be noted, and will be exchanged for [[nest box]]es if there is not enough room in the inventory. These boxes can be extracted at a bank to obtain the nests.

===Clue nest===
{{Main|Clue nest}}
Clue nests are nests that can be found while training [[Woodcutting]] or emptying [[bird house trapping|bird houses]] on [[Fossil Island]]. Searching them will give players a [[clue scroll]] of the indicated difficulty, leaving an empty bird nest. Like clue scrolls, players can only have one of each type of clue nest in their possession.

===Empty nest===
{{Main|Bird nest (empty)}}
Most nests produce an empty nest after searching their contents. Empty nests can be crushed with a [[pestle and mortar]] to get a [[crushed nest]], which is used in [[Herblore]] to create [[Saradomin brews]]. Bird nests are only tradeable when empty or crushed.

Some activities can also provide empty nests, such as bird house trapping and trading mole parts with Wyson.

==Discontinued nests==
===Wyson nests (2006-2016)===
{{Main|Bird nest (Wyson, 2006-2016)}}
Seed nests from [[Wyson]] originally rewarded relatively low level seeds, and were considered to not be valuable enough compared to the difficulty of the content. To improve the nests, Wyson nests were [[Update:Dragon Claws & 3rd Birthday|updated]] on [[18 February]] [[2016]] to reward more valuable seeds. Wyson nests obtained prior to this update could still exist in player banks and inventories and can be searched to provide seeds from the original reward table.

===Pre-Farming Guild===
{{Main|Bird nest (seeds, 2005-2019)}}
{{Main|Bird nest (Wyson, 2016-2019)}}
Seed nests and Wyson nests were updated on [[10 January]] [[2019]] with the [[Update:The Kebos Lowlands|release]] of the [[Farming Guild]]. All nests previously obtained would remain in banks and inventories, and new nests would be added that contained [[dragonfruit tree seed|dragonfruit]], [[celastrus seed|celastrus]], and [[redwood tree seed]]s. [[Snape grass seed]]s were also added to Wyson nests. This change was made to prevent players from obtaining large quantities of the new seeds immediately upon release of the content.
